description: Single-column centered hero. Strongest when the page is editorial / minimal — no product visual to anchor, the headline is the visual.

brand.hint: Eyebrow above the headline (uses bracket-style decorators). 1-3 words.

title.hint: 5-10 words. Long enough to fill the centered display setting (clamp scales to 5rem on wide screens). Editorial tone — declarative, not salesy.

subtitle.hint: One sentence, 12-22 words. Sets context for who this is for.

secondaryCta.hint: Use sparingly — centered hero loses focus with two equal-weight CTAs.

preview.title: Quiet brands that age well.
preview.subtitle: Identity and editorial design for founders who'd rather be remembered than recognized.
